title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Bar Chart — Household Recycling Rates by Material Type
prompt: The bar chart below shows the percentage of household waste recycled for four different material types in a fictional country called Valdoria, in the years 2005, 2015 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为学术类 Task 1 练习，主题为“最弱项目补强与迁移复测”。请先观察柱状图：四条横轴类别（纸张、玻璃、塑料、金属）在三个年份（2005、2015、2025）的回收率百分比。写作时注意：概述主要趋势与类别之间的对比，不要逐条罗列所有数字；用准确的数据支撑比较；不要给出个人观点或解释原因。所有场景与数据均为模拟，并非官方雅思试卷。请用英文作答，字数不少于150词。
